experiences.organization: Foster School of Business, University of Washington
experiences.summary: VP of Foster Tech Club and AI Product Builder, focused on product strategy, customer research, AI prototyping, go-to-market thinking, and product leadership.

projects.title: AI Hike Researcher
projects.description: Interviewed 2 hike organizers to identify planning pain points; architected AI Hike Researcher, a cost and time efficient AI agent that gathers 6 real-time safety signals and personalizes trail filtering, reducing weekly planning time by 98%.

projects.title: Spotify AI MiniMix
projects.description: Built an AI music recommendation engine in n8n for mood and occasion sub-playlist curation, using dynamic song-feature selection and improving relevance by 73% versus a rule-based baseline in project testing.

projects.title: StreakFit AI
projects.description: Discovered 3 student fitness pain points through 6 hypothesis-driven interviews; built a 0-to-1 personalized AI gym buddy MVP in 3 hours at the OpenAI Codex Hackathon; now targeting a broader release and iterating on v3 with AI features including check-ins, a conversational chatbot, and in-app nudges.

projects.title: Asana Sales Strategy and GTM Assessment
projects.description: Benchmarked Asana's sales strategy and go-to-market motion across nine dimensions, recommending clearer PLG vs. SLG guidance and competitive differentiation. Awarded 1st place for best assessment out of eight teams.

projects.title: HeyLily AI Scam-Call Assistant
projects.description: Led an 11-member cross-functional team across design, engineering, and business to build HeyLily, a Hiya competitor and AI scam-call assistant for seniors. Guided development of an android call app, and crafted a 5-year B2B2C go-to-market model.

projects.title: Product Teardown Series
projects.description: Ideated, launched, and ran the Foster Tech Club program that made product thinking more social and hands-on; created event marketing, posters, Luma pages, and audience messaging; produced three teardown events with 110+ attendees.

projects.title: Roblox Foster Case
projects.description: Proposed Roblox, a user-generated-content platform, as the acquirer for Shutterstock in the Foster Case Competition. Presented a $1.5B valuation and synergy analysis showing how Shutterstock assets could expand Roblox creator tools, content quality, and market share.

projects.title: Microsoft 365 Copilot GTM Strategy
projects.description: Developed a go-to-market strategy for Microsoft 365 Copilot to capture 1% of the U.S. university student market, modeling $2.9M in value over four years. Positioned Copilot as a Gen Z-facing AI productivity product through campus adoption, value messaging, and education-focused GTM tactics.

projects.title: Quantum Tech Partners Gaming GTM
projects.description: Produced four milestone reports on South Korea's gaming sector, covering market sizing, developer and publisher mapping, growth themes, and investment analysis. Turned the research into a prioritized outreach list of six targets to guide 2025 go-to-market planning.

projects.title: SBS Consulting Strategy
projects.description: Developed a structured consulting analysis for SBS, turning client context, market research, and strategic signals into prioritized recommendations, supporting rationale, and an executive-ready presentation.

experiences.title: Product Management Fellowship
experiences.summary: Selected as a Top Fellow with 2nd rank in NextLeap’s Product Management Fellowship, focused on structured product thinking, customer pain-point analysis, and capstone problem solving.

projects.title: Bumble Barney AI Wingman
projects.description: Analyzed 100 one-star Bumble App Store ratings, root-caused the recurring no-matches problem, brainstormed solutions, and proposed Bumble Barney, an AI wingman intended to decrease no matches by 10%. Won 2nd rank in the February NextLeap Capstone project.

projects.title: Netflix Circle Wireframes
projects.description: Designed wireframes for a Netflix social discovery concept, exploring how friend circles, onboarding, and recommendation flows could make content discovery more social and habit-forming.

projects.title: Netflix New User Onboarding Journey Map
projects.description: Created a user persona and mapped Netflix's new-user onboarding journey to identify friction points, emotional states, and opportunities to improve activation, personalization, and first-session value. Published the journey map on Figma, where it received 650+ uses and 17+ likes.

projects.title: Figma Product Design Work
projects.description: Collected product design explorations in Figma, including journey maps, wireframes, and interface concepts that show product thinking across discovery, interaction design, and user experience.

experiences.title: Senior Product Manager Technical, AWS FinOps
experiences.summary: Worked on AWS FinOps cost optimization strategy, customer discovery, roadmap prioritization, and PRFAQ-style product definition.

experiences.title: Technical Product Manager, Azure Storage
experiences.summary: Led Azure Core Storage product and engineering work across Blob NFS, AI incident diagnosis, distributed caching, and high-throughput infrastructure for enterprise and HPC workloads.

projects.title: WSLBlobNFS PowerShell Module and Package Distribution
projects.description: Spearheaded the 0-to-1 development and launch of a Windows CLI client using WSL2 virtualization for Blob NFS, unlocking a new Windows segment and onboarding 150+ B2B customers while partnering with product leadership on go-to-market strategy.

projects.title: BlobNFS Troubleshooting Tool
projects.description: Built troubleshooting tooling to diagnose Azure Blob NFS issues, collect useful logs, and support faster root-cause analysis for users and Azure support workflows.

experiences.title: Software Engineer, Azure Core Monitor & Migrate
experiences.summary: Built Azure Monitor and Migrate product experiences and cloud infrastructure improvements across UX, performance, cost, reliability, and disaster recovery.

experiences.summary: Completed an advanced AI/ML certification focused on machine learning and deep learning, placing 3rd in the capstone project.

projects.title: Advanced AI/ML Capstone
projects.description: Completed the Advanced AI/ML Certification capstone at IIIT Hyderabad and placed 3rd for the project.

experiences.title: Bachelor of Engineering, Computer Science
experiences.summary: Graduated with a 9.5 CGPA, ranked in the top 5% of the class.

projects.title: Sketch-to-Image AI Tool
projects.description: Built an AI tool that transforms hand-drawn sketches into realistic images using Convolutional Neural Networks and Generative Adversarial Networks. Won 2nd place in the final-year project competition for applying computer vision and generative modeling to creative image generation.

aboutProfile.title: AI-First Technical Product Manager
aboutProfile.context: AWS PMT-ES ✦ Microsoft Azure ✦ UW Foster STEM MBA
intro: Hi 👋, I’m Shankar, an AI-first Technical Product Manager who brings curiosity, technical depth, product taste, and grit to ambiguous problems. I like taking messy customer problems, figuring out what matters, and working with cross-functional teams to ship something useful. I stay involved from early discovery through launch, making tradeoffs, setting direction, and keeping the work moving. I care about building products that are easy to use, scale well, and earn customer trust.
Outside product work, I’m usually hiking, working out, or trying to understand why people behave the way they do.
aboutProfile.featuredProductsIntro: A snapshot of a few products and prototypes I’ve built, tested, and shaped across AI, consumer, and community experiences.
